title: Elon Musk wanted an OpenAI for-profit
summary: Elon Musk’s latest legal filing against OpenAI marks his fourth attempt in less than a year to reframe his claims. However, his own words and actions speak for themselves—in 2017, Elon not only wanted, but actually created, a for-profit as OpenAI’s proposed new structure.
body: Elon Musk’s latest legal filing against OpenAI marks his fourth attempt in less than a year to reframe his claims. However, his own words and actions speak for themselves—in 2017, Elon not only wanted, but actually created, a for-profit as OpenAI’s proposed new structure.
summaryZh: 马斯克针对OpenAI提起了最新法律诉讼，而OpenAI通过回应指出马斯克在2017年也曾提议并创建过营利性结构，双方围绕公司性质和历史文件展开了口水战。
